title: IoT Labs — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: IoT lab activities help students understand sensors, devices, data, networks, and automation.

blocks.heading: How students learn IoT
paras: Students connect hardware, software, and data to understand how modern smart systems work.

groups.title: Device Basics
text: Hands-on exposure to microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, and embedded systems.

groups.title: Connectivity
text: Understand how devices communicate through networks, protocols, and cloud services.

groups.title: Data Monitoring
text: Collect, visualize, and interpret sensor data for practical decision-making.

groups.title: Automation
text: Build simple automated responses for classrooms, farms, homes, and workplaces.

groups.title: Smart Applications
text: Explore IoT applications in agriculture, education, health, and local businesses.

blocks.heading: Build practical connected systems
paras: Learn more about technology programs and student project opportunities.
